primary_metric: accepted correct target and SO(3) error <= 0.16 rad without drop; scorer termination
limits: Small development comparison, not a paper-level result. Latent head is aligned to six existing skills; its periodic supervisor is not learned. Astra requires an API credential and actual calls. Previous v3 validation is never training data. V4 resets refresh colored markers, and uses disjoint layout banks, so old v3 numbers are not directly comparable.
